title: event_xmlrpc Module
content_markdown: This module is an implementation of an XMLRPC client used to notify XMLRPC servers whenever certain notifications are raised by OpenSIPS. It acts as a transport layer for the Event Notification Interface.
overview: This module is an implementation of an XMLRPC client used to notify XMLRPC servers whenever certain notifications are raised by OpenSIPS. It acts as a transport layer for the Event Notification Interface.
how_it_works: Basicly, the module executes a remote procedure call when an event is raised from OpenSIPS's script, core or modules using the Event Interface. In order to be notified, an XMLRPC server has to subscribe for a certain event provided by OpenSIPS. This can be done using the generic MI Interface (_event_subscribe_ function) or from OpenSIPS script (_subscribe_event_ core function).

exported_parameters.name: use_struct_param
exported_parameters.description: When raising an event, pack the name and value of the parameters in a XMLRPC structure. This provides an easier way for some XMLRPC server implementations to interpret the parameters. Set it to zero to disable or to non-zero to enable it.
